title: Administrator
description:
Our client are currently recruiting for a Customer Service Administrator to work within the Additional Units team in the Commercial Sales Office, based at their head office in Barnsley. You will join them on a full time, permanent basis and in return will receive a competitive salary.

As one of the UK s leading manufacturers of Kitchen, Bedroom and Bathroom fitted furniture, our client has had unsuppressed growth, with almost 50 years experience. Their emphasis is on providing a high standard for all their products and the services they offer. They are currently seeking the very best people, to further strengthen their position within the industry by appointing dedicated individuals to share in their success.

As an Administrator, your key responsibilities will include:
- Handling telephone enquiries from homeowners / occupiers.
- Dealing with email enquiries.
- Giving prices, taking orders and processing card payments.
- Processing orders and defects whilst ensuring that deadlines are achieved.
- Notifying customers of their delivery slots.
- Responsibility for general administration duties.
- Undertaking other such duties and responsibilities, as and when requested.

To meet the requirements of their Administrator you must be:
- An excellent telephone manner.
- Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Strong organisational skills.
- A keen eye for detail as accuracy is important.
- Strong IT skills.
- Excellent timekeeping and time management skills

As their Administrator, you will also be able to:
- Work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
- Meet strict deadlines.
- Communicate with people at all levels.

This position will be rewarded with a competitive salary. In order for your application to be taken further please state your required salary.

If this sounds like the perfect opportunity for you and you d like to become their Administrator, then please click apply today don t miss out, they d love to hear from you!

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance AssistantBarnsley Full-time £27,000 - £31,000 Elevation Recruitment Group are working with a well-established, growing business in Barnsley that's looking to recruit a confident and detail-focused Finance Assistant. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a friendly finance team in a role that covers a broad range of responsibilities - from purchase ledger to payroll and credit control support.Benefits Include:
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays (increasing with service)
- Life assurance - 4x salary
- Company pension contribution
- Health cash plan and lifestyle discounts (post-probation)
- Progression opportunities
- Holiday buying scheme

The Finance Assistant's Duties & Responsibilities include:
- Managing the purchase ledger: processing invoices, credit notes, delivery notes, and ensuring authorisation is in place
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving queries promptly
- Processing multi-currency invoices and payments, with accurate ledger allocations
- Preparing weekly payment proposals and updating cashflow forecasts
- Supporting the production of GRNI reports and accounts payable balance sheet entries
- Handling employee expenses and reconciling petty cash
- Collaborating with internal budget holders to ensure timely invoice approvals and payments

Key Skills & Experience required:
- AAT Level 3 (or currently studying)
- Previous experience in a purchase ledger or similar transactional finance role
- Comfortable working with multi-currency transactions
- Confident using Excel and accounting software
- Excellent attention to detail and time management skills
- A team player with strong communication and problem-solving abilities

Interested? Apply now or get in touch with Jess Gazda for a confidential chat about the role.

title: German Speaking Administrator
description:
An established manufacturer of CNC Machinery is looking for a German-Speaking Internal Sales Executive to manage relationships with customers across Europe. Sales experience isn't essential; strong manufacturing/engineering administration or coordination experience, excellent German communication skills and a customer-focused approach are what matter.

The Role

Working as part of the internal sales and commercial team, you will be responsible for supporting German-speaking customers throughout the sales and order process.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Building strong relationships with key customers in the UK and Europe.
- Preparing and following up quotations and sales enquiries.
- Processing customer orders and ensuring information is accurately communicated.
- Providing customers with updates regarding orders, lead times and deliveries.
- Handling customer queries and resolving issues in a professional and timely manner.
- Supporting the wider sales team with administration and customer management.
- Assisting with export documentation and shipments where required.
- Working with customers and internal teams to ensure orders are delivered accurately and on time.

About You

We are looking for someone fluent in German and confident communicating with customers in both written and spoken German.

Previous sales experience is not essential. What is important is that you are commercially minded, organised, confident communicating with customers and comfortable working in a manufacturing or engineering environment.

Ideally, you will have:
- Fluent German language skills - essential.
- Experience working within manufacturing, engineering or another technical environment.
- Strong administration and organisational skills.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of up to £35,000, depending on experience.
- The opportunity to join an established manufacturing business.
- A varied role combining customer service, sales support, administration and international business.
- A role where your German language skills will be genuinely valuable to the business.

If you're a fluent German speaker with experience in manufacturing, engineering, administration, customer service or sales and are looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to find out more.

ASC Connections Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. We are committed to equal opportunity and diversity.
